topic: The Infinite Beauty of the Wallis Product for Pi
target_audience: Undergraduate STEM students or advanced high school students

sections.title: Introduction: Pi Beyond Geometry
lecture_lines: Pi is usually defined as circumference over diameter.
But Pi can also be an infinite product.
John Wallis discovered a surprising pattern.
animations: Write 'Pi = Circumference / Diameter' on screen in #FFD700.
Clear screen and write Pi as infinite product in #00FFFF.
Show portrait of John Wallis; highlight pattern in #FF4500.

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Power of Limits
lecture_lines: We use infinite products, not just sums.
These products converge to specific numerical values.
Think of limits squeezing toward a target.
animations: Display infinite product expression; highlight the product operator #FFD700.
Show values converging; visualize squeezing sequence toward target #00FFFF.
Display limit symbol; fade in target value #FF4500.

sections.title: Deriving the Wallis Formula
lecture_lines: Wallis formula relates Pi to simple ratios.
The pattern uses even numbers flanking odds.
Each term brings us closer to Pi.
animations: Highlight even numbers in top, odds in bottom; apply color #7FFFD4.
Show full Wallis product sequence expanding; fade in Pi symbol #FF00FF.

sections.title: Why Does It Work? Intuition
lecture_lines: It comes from integrals of sine powers.
Comparing these integrals reveals the elegant formula.
Waveforms morph to capture the area precisely.
animations: Animate sine wave changing power; fade between curves #FF6347.
Display definite integral expressions; compare side-by-side #FFFF00.
Overlay areas under curves; illustrate ratio change #00FF00.

sections.title: Application: The Convergence Race
lecture_lines: Wallis product converges slowly to Pi.
Modern series are much more efficient.
It is a beautiful, but steady race.
animations: Show terms accumulating slowly; visualize progress bar #DC143C.
Compare Wallis product vs modern series growth; speed labels #ADFF2F.
Final convergence animation; Pi value glows brightly #FFD700.
